f17r.name: Plant
f17r.looks: Three dark blue flower heads on green cups, a tall green stem with long narrow green leaves in pairs, and a fine brown root with red marks.

f17v.name: Plant
f17v.looks: A green stem arching over the top with clusters of small red berries and a curling tendril, broad green leaves down the right, and a long hairy tan root lying along the bottom.

f18r.name: Plant
f18r.looks: One large blue flower with a red centre and three small buds on top of an upright green stem with broad green leaves, over a spreading brown root.

f18v.name: Plant
f18v.looks: A round flower head of scales and fringe with red dots in its centre, a branched green stem with lobed green leaves, and a thick tan root spreading sideways into flame-like lobes and a curled tail.

f19r.name: Plant
f19r.looks: A dark blue flower with a pale rim, small blue-and-white flower clusters, toothed green leaves on a thin stem, two large drooping green fronds, and a tan root rising into a cup-shaped top.

f19v.name: Plant
f19v.looks: Three small dark blue flowers on thin stalks above two dense tufts of green foliage on a pale green stem, which rises from a brownish-red root with spreading legs.

f20r.name: Plant
f20r.looks: Several upright stalks with rows of small green leaflets, red leaflets and blue buds at the tips, over a pale tan root.

f20v.name: Plant
f20v.looks: A green stem with branching stalks ending in fringed flower heads with dark blue tops, long narrow green leaves bound in bunches across the stems, and a pale tan root at the bottom.

f21r.name: Plant
f21r.looks: Many green branches spreading out like a star from a dense centre, lined with small green leaves and strings of tan beads, over thin brown roots.

f21v.name: Plant
f21v.looks: Blue flowers with red tips on thin pale branching stalks, long leaves made of curved green segments on both sides of the stem, and a brown looped root at the bottom.

f22r.name: Plant
f22r.looks: Three dark blue round flower heads at the top, a fan of pale stalks carrying strings of small red-and-white beads, round green leaves with pale edges, pale paired stems and a spreading red-brown root.

f22v.name: Plant
f22v.looks: A large pale closed flower with a blue and gold top on a tall thin stem, long green leaves made of many curved strips, and a thick red-brown thorny root curled round with white rings.

f23r.name: Plant
f23r.looks: Two leafy stems, each rising from a pale cup, with many hand-shaped green leaves and small blue flowers at the tops, standing on one long log-like tan root with thin roots below.

f23v.name: Plant
f23v.looks: A blue star-shaped flower with a round centre on top, a dense crown of rounded green and olive leaves, two lower clusters of leaves with small blue flowers, a pale stem and a spreading red-brown root.

f24r.name: Plant
f24r.looks: Two tall stems with large pale daisy-like flowers held under hooded green tops, many small curled green leaves, the stems twisting together at the base into long pale wavy roots.

f24v.name: Plant
f24v.looks: Four dark blue flowers in pale cups on curving stalks, round green leaves with long pointed tails along a pale stem, and a bunch of tapering brown roots.

f25r.name: Plant
f25r.looks: A thin pale stem with pairs of broad green leaves and small red-brown buds where the leaves meet the stem, a cluster of larger green leaves at the top, and a small red-brown root with straight side branches.

f25v.name: Plant
f25v.looks: A star of long pointed green leaves spreading from one centre, a long green leaf trailing down to the right, and a pale red-brown root drawn with fine hatching.

f25v.name: Small dragon
f25v.looks: A small animal drawn in brown outline only, standing upright with a long neck, an open mouth, two pointed ears, short forelegs, clawed feet and a scaly belly.

f26r.name: Plant
f26r.looks: Two long thin stalks rising to clusters of small dark blue berries at the top, rounded green leaves with scalloped edges on a pale branching stem, and a red-brown root tied at the top and splitting into long strands.

f26v.name: Plant
f26v.looks: A pale branching stem with two big feather-like green leaves on each side, made of rows of small round green lobes, a spray of white-and-blue cup-shaped flowers at the top, and a spreading red-brown root with looping strands.

f27r.name: Plant
f27r.looks: Two dark blue bell-shaped flowers and a pale leafy sprig at the top of a thin stem, three large pointed green leaves with fine veins, a long bare stem below and a root curving out to both sides.

f27r.name: Small plant
f27r.looks: Three round green leaves with wavy edges on thin forked stalks, a pale stem, and a short tan root with curved strands at the bottom.

f27v.name: Plant
f27v.looks: Several tall thin stalks ending in pale star-like flowers with red centres and fine rays, small blue buds, many toothed green leaves along branching pale stems, and a lumpy brown root.

f28r.name: Plant
f28r.looks: A tall thin pale-red stem carrying three ribbed white seed-like heads, the top one with a yellow-and-red tip, a ring of wavy green leaves with curled tips round the lowest head, and a red root with curling tentacle-like strands.

f28v.name: Plant
f28v.looks: A wide ring of curved green leaflets on thin wavy stalks round a bare centre, a green stem with a small ribbed bud and two pointed green leaves, and a pale tan root splitting into long tapering strands.

f29r.name: Plant
f29r.looks: A tall ribbed head with a red top and a ring of red berries, a pale fringed cup below, curved overlapping leaves in green, dark blue and olive with curled tips, two long thin stems and fine pale roots fanning out along the bottom.

f29v.name: Plant
f29v.looks: A dark blue flower with pale tips and green sepals at the top, six green bell-shaped buds on thin pale stalks, two big feathery olive-green leaves curving down like horns, a long bare stem and a flat grey-green root lying sideways.

f30r.name: Plant
f30r.looks: A curved stalk hung with small dark blue pod-shaped flowers, three groups of long pointed green leaves along a thin pale stem, and fine pale roots at the bottom.
